metadata.case_name: LO CHI BUN v. LEUNG WAH KWAN

plaintiff.occupation_after: casual construction site worker (odd jobs on construction sites); seeking work as a watchman

injuries.description: 3% compound fracture of the metacarpal bones 3, 4 and 5 right.
source: Examination showed that he had 3% compound fracture of the metacarpal bones 3, 4 and 5 right.

injuries.description: fracture of the proximal phalanges of the ring and little fingers
injuries.body_part: right ring and little fingers (proximal phalanges)
source: An x-ray of the right hand showed a fracture of the proximal phalanges of the ring and little fingers.
On operation, it was found that ... fractures of the proximal phalanxes of the right ring and little fingers

injuries.description: disruption of the metacarpo-phalangeal joint of the right ring finger and 100% cut extensors to the middle, ring and little finger (complete cut of the extensor tendons to the middle, ring and little fingers)
injuries.body_part: right middle, ring and little fingers / right hand (extensor tendons; MCP joint of ring finger)
source: On operation, it was found that there was disruption of the metacarpo-phalangeal joint of the right ring finger, ... and l00% cut extensors to the middle, ring and little finger.

Mr. LO suffered severe injury to his dominant upper limb with a deep cut over the dorsum of the hand resulting in disruption of the MCP joint of the ring finger, fracture of the proximal phalanx of the ring and little fingers, and complete cut of the extensor tendons to the middle, ring and little fingers.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: stiffness and weakness of the right hand
the middle finger suffers the least with stiffness of the distal interphalangeal joint
the ring finger has no active movement at all; the whole finger remains straight and protruded when a full grip is attempted
the interphalangeal joints of the little finger have also been ankylosed and the little finger cannot flex properly to form a firm grip
the power of the hand grip is significantly impaired; very poor grip; cannot hold things tightly and things drop from his hand easily
decreased touch and pain sensation over the dorsum of the ring and little fingers
cannot use the ring or little finger; little finger has lost function
cannot hold an electric saw or drills or heavy objects

treatments_received: debridement and temporary fixation of the fractures
definitive fixation of the fractures and tendon repair
removal of the implants and tendon release

losses.description: Cannot use the ring or little finger; significant permanent disability of dominant right hand; loss of function of little and ring fingers; complete cut extensor tendons

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Prior to the accident he played badminton, basketball, table tennis and cycling; he cannot play sports any more.
He cannot return to work as a carpenter and can only consider lighter jobs such as messenger, security guard or lift operator; loss of ability to continue previous skilled occupation.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong see mo v. Lam nam fui and ors.
comparable_cases.injury_description: a 37 year old carpenter suffered an electric circular saw accident to his left hand, resulting in the loss of the distal phalanx of his index finger, parts of the distal and middle phalanges of his middle finger and the distal phalanx of his ring finger

comparable_cases.case_name: Tsang chin-keung v. LO tat kong
comparable_cases.injury_description: 27 year old carpenter injured his left (preferred) hand when it was cut in a circular saw; underwent operations including nerve graft; loss of sensation and strength, constant pain
